_README: Two hundred and nine sentences a real patient might type, and the units of care a careful reader would say each one names. Used by scripts/eval-mapper.mjs (rules alone vs rules plus the AI reader, end to end through POST /api/map) and by scripts/eval-models.mjs (one model against another on the same corpus). Nothing here is a real person: every sentence was written for this file from the catalog's own labels and plain_language_synonyms, and there is no PHI in it. `expect` is a SET of catalog ids from data/prices.json - the metric ignores counts and order, because segmentation differs between readers and the question is which units were found. An empty `expect` is a sentence that must produce NO priced unit at all: a wait, a symptom, a feeling, care that was refused or denied or skipped, care someone else had, or care only wondered about. `kind` groups the sentences so precision can be read per category: control, lay, count, wait, not-received, symptom, mixed, typo, place, hypothetical, someone-else, demo.
_written_by: Cases 1-30: BUILD-8 measurement lane, 2026-09-09. Cases 31-185 and 186-209: READER-2 lane, 2026-09-09, written by hand from data/prices.json labels and data/synonyms.json - no model wrote a sentence or an expectation. The expectations are one careful reader's judgment, not an external gold standard; that limit is stated wherever the numbers are quoted.
_catalog_checked_against: data/prices.json + data/prices-additions-2026-09-09.json (251 selectable rows on 2026-09-09); every id in every `expect` is checked to exist and be selectable by scripts/eval-models.mjs, which exits 2 on an orphan.
